title: SWE-Flow
input: A working supported Python repository and traces from SWE-Flow-Trace.
native_output: Partial codebases, restoration patches, schedules and specifications.

conversion.approach: Package the upstream skeleton, specification, restoration patch and selected tests; execute labels rather than assuming they passed.

deviations: One published spectree runtime, five tests, seed 42, two trace workers
GPT-4o replaces native model defaults for 31 docstrings and four specifications
Preserved patch bytes and used git apply --inaccurate-eof -p0 for native EOF metadata
Harbor packaging removes installed healthy package, backup source and git history; hidden tests copied only for verification
known_limitations: Trace-derived test IDs are not execution receipts. Preserve original archives privately and keep them outside the learner image.

why_this_order: Next reproduce repository reconstruction after the prepared-image workflow is stable.
